summary.intent: Deliver presentation-grade 3D architecture with per-room finishes and coordinated colour palettes, a whole-floor potential-flow breeze solver, and an interactive 3D Vastu zone overlay.
summary.outcome: Shipped two-leaf PBR 3D models with 12 ranked colour palettes, potential-flow indoor breeze simulation with live particle advection, and 3D Vastu floor grids with remedy move arcs.

repo: glTF PBR factors are linear RGB; converting authored sRGB colours and merging collinear duplicate wall segments eliminates washed-out finishes and coplanar wall flicker.
Potential-flow grid solve with resistive window/door cuts captures cross-ventilation paths and dead-air pockets across the whole floorplate.

code.finding: Two-leaf wall construction gives every room independent paint, tile dado, and feature-wall finishes.
Computes 9-cell Vastu grid geometry, per-room verdict pins, and 3D remedy vectors to ideal quarters.

workflow: Keep sRGB-to-linear conversion centralized in arch3d material construction.

friction: Coplanar duplicate walls between adjacent rooms caused z-fighting flicker in Three.js until collinear wall merging was added prior to mesh extrusion.
open_items: Add a pre-search programme feasibility gate, lock multi-storey stair footprints across mutations, and enforce room aspect-ratio and plot-filling bounds.
